rows.note: Use this in casual speech when the pleasing aesthetic effect is mainly visual or concerns how something looks.

example.english: Aesthetically, this jacket looks quite stylish.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 ngoi6 tou3 tai2 lok6 gei2 jau5 jing4

rows.note: Use this as the more general, all-purpose choice when discussing aesthetic quality or design rather than just visual appearance.

example.english: Aesthetically, the design of this building is quite successful.
example.traditional: 呢座建築物嘅設計喺美學上相當成功。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 gin3 zuk1 mat6 ge3 cit3 gai3 hai2 mei5 hok6 soeng6 soeng1 dong1 sing4 gung1
